summary: The recorded base selects the dynamically resolved cudaMemcpyBatchAsync ABI from compile-time CUDA_VERSION and therefore misplaces arguments when CUDA 12.8 headers are paired with a CUDA 13 runtime. The candidate selects the 8- or 9-argument ABI from cudaRuntimeGetVersion() and directly covers the reported mismatch. Independent testing also covered the reverse header/runtime mismatch. Real NVIDIA execution was unavailable, but the ABI contract and dispatch behavior were verified with native C++ harnesses.

tests.what_was_measured: Base-equivalent CUDA 12.8 compile-time dispatch into an 8-argument CUDA 13 mock receives failIdx instead of the intended stream, reproducing the ABI mismatch without claiming an NVIDIA segfault.
Candidate regression compiled with CUDA_VERSION=12080 and dispatched correctly at runtime version boundaries 12999 and 13000; 1 passed.
Independent mirror-image case compiled with CUDA_VERSION=13000 and correctly invoked both CUDA 12.8 nine-argument and CUDA 13 eight-argument mock entry points.
Existing staged write-back dispatch boundaries and fallback behavior; 16 passed, 1 skipped.
Freshly rebuilt gfx950 staged HiCache JIT device/host round-trip equality; 12 passed. This measures only the ROCm path.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 executed 12 freshly rebuilt staged HiCache JIT round-trip tests. No NVIDIA GPU was available.

remaining_limitations: No NVIDIA GPU, nvcc 12.8, or CUDA 13 libcudart was available, so the exact reported SIGSEGV and actual dlsym-resolved CUDA entry point were not executed.
The fresh gfx950 native rebuild preprocesses out the changed CUDA-only branch and therefore does not qualify as a rebuild of that branch.
The reported 27B AWQ checkpoint, TP2 topology, and full serving path were not reproduced; the issue-specific failure is below those layers and was tested at its ABI boundary.
No NVIDIA compiler or ISA evidence could be collected in the ROCm-only environment.
